1¾ cups butter, room temperature, divided
2 egg yolks
1 tsp. vanilla extract

1⁄2 tsp. salt

Ingredients:

1 pound (450g) dry white rice

1 tablespoon (15ml) olive oil

1 onion, chopped

2 cloves of garlic, minced

2 fresh green chiles or one fresh red pepper, seeded and minced

2 teaspoons (10ml) ground coriander

2 teaspoons (10ml) ground cumin

2 teaspoons (10ml) salt

1/4 teaspoon (1ml) ground allspice

1 can (15 ounces; 420g) tomato sauce

1 can (28 ounces; 740ml) diced tomatoes

2 cups (480g) uncooked or cooked rice

2 tablespoons (30g) fresh parsley or 1 teaspoon (5g) dry

Method:

2.  Transfer to a bowl.   Add the coriander, cumin, salt, allspice, tomato sauce, and diced tomatoes.  Stir well.

3.  Season with more salt to taste.

4.  Add the rice and stir to coat in the tomato sauce mixture.

5.  Cover the pan, reduce heat to medium-low, and continue to cook 8 to 10 minutes or until there is no more liquid in the pan.

6.  Remove from heat.  Add parsley.  Stir well, and serve.
